title: LocationRegistryPin/v1 (CANDIDATE)
description: CANDIDATE separately versioned envelope that binds the EXACT BYTES of one LocationRegistry/v1 document by sha256 (KCLIVE-03, KC-Brain 6708734290 B). It is supplied by the caller from a TRUSTED source, never read from the registry it pins, and LocationRegistry/v1 itself gains no revision field. registry_revision is a free-form label and is NOT a pin: only registry_sha256, recomputed over the bytes actually read, pins. An authorised issuer/revision witness does not exist yet: issuer_witness MUST be absent or null and is reported NOT_MEASURED; this envelope never claims source admission.

issuer_witness.description: Reserved. No real issuer exists; any non-null value is refused.
